items: 01 PLANNER + CONNECTOR: Own ONLY reports/round-5/01-plan-review.md. Read claims.json, SCORECARD.md, tools/check-craft-exercise.py and reports/supplement-opencode-1/29-local-boundaries.md. Check the two claims for causal separation and falsifiability; trace the language/myth/era/dress implications of the twenty unresolved rows. Identify regression checks and typed-adapter debts without redefining targets or editing code. This is author-side planning evidence, not an admission decision.

02 EXECUTOR craft CLI: Own ONLY tools/check-craft-exercise.py and reports/round-5/02-craft-cli.md. Six observed baseline cases crash with exit1/traceback: missing argument, missing file, malformed JSON, non-UTF-8, wrong root shape, missing --report value. Normalize those to exit2 with stable diagnostic IDs and no traceback. Preserve genuine findings exit1, positive run/--counts, read-only optional --report (an existing report), original law semantics and all ten mutation detections. Add isolated real CLI positive/negative selftests, no dependencies, no broad exception swallowing that hides programming defects. Run from another cwd too. Do not edit the exercise, existing reports or tools/gates. Record actual tests and limits.

03 EXECUTOR isolated battery: Own ONLY new tools/check-gate-battery.py and reports/round-5/03-isolated-battery.md. Implement a stdlib standalone CLI that copies the seven existing tools/gates/*.py and their fixture tree into a disposable mirror, then runs each --selftest there, never on live paths. Preserve original file bytes and report all seven observed exits. Exits: 0 all pass, 1 test failure, 2 could-not-evaluate (missing/unsafe input, launch/timeout). Add --selftest with isolated positive and negative exit/stable-ID controls, including failing child and missing-gate cases. Default invocation must exercise the actual seven gates. Do not change gate scripts or fixtures; copying is not proof that the legacy selftests themselves became read-only. Bounded diagnostics, no manifest-command execution or arbitrary shell strings. Record actual commands and limitations.

14 REVIEWER provenance: Own ONLY reports/round-5/14-source-review.md. Read the twenty prior unresolved rows and declared source schema. Identify specific false-confirmation risks, source authority and coupling pitfalls. Inspect any already-completed new ledgers once if available; otherwise say not reviewed. Never fabricate future source results or treat catalogue/access success as content evidence. No corpus or ledger edits.

15 MUTATION REVIEWER CLI: Own ONLY reports/round-5/15-cli-review.md, with temporary probes under reports/supplement-opencode-1/scratch/round5-15/. Examine the baseline craft checker and isolated-battery approach for malformed input, accidental live writes, option confusion and misleading exit semantics. Run bounded baseline counterexamples; inspect landed executor output only if actually available. No edits to worker code, no exploit payload persistence outside scratch, no source/replay mutation.

16 CRITIC calibration: Own ONLY reports/round-5/16-calibration-critic.md. Review claims.json against SCORECARD.md, previous acceptance receipts, and legacy gate/replay contracts. List falsifiers and all-six-axis no-harm checks, explain why safe battery wrapping does not fix underlying selftest conformance, and flag any counting-as-quality or independent-review laundering. Do not redefine targets, judge admission, edit code, or claim outputs you did not inspect.
